$comment: The one list. install.ps1 and the website both read this file at runtime, so shipping a new app means editing here and nowhere else. Versions and download links are never written down — they are resolved from each repo's latest release, so this file does not go stale.

tagline.en: Pin text and images on top of anything
tagline.zh: 把文字、圖片釘在螢幕最上層

desc.en: A transparent, frameless layer that floats above every window. For notes, references and anything you need to keep looking at.
desc.zh: 透明無邊框的浮層,蓋在所有視窗之上。放提示、參考資料,或任何需要一直看著的東西。

desc.en: Select, annotate, copy. Starts instantly and stays out of the way.
desc.zh: 框選、標註、複製。開啟即用,不囉嗦。

desc.en: Grab any region of the screen and get its text on the clipboard.
desc.zh: 框住畫面上任何一塊,文字直接進剪貼簿。

tagline.en: Watch, study and cut your own video library

desc.en: A local video player that transcribes what it plays: search every line across a whole show, read along in two languages, cut highlights, and watch it all from your phone.
desc.zh: 會自己聽寫的本機播放器:整部劇的台詞都搜得到、中英對照邊看邊學、挑句子剪精華,手機也看得到。

tagline.en: Resize a folder of images at once
tagline.zh: 整個資料夾的圖一次改好

desc.en: Batch resize and convert, with the settings you actually use kept to hand.
desc.zh: 批次改尺寸和格式,常用的設定隨手可取。

tagline.en: See what is eating your RAM
tagline.zh: 看清楚記憶體被誰吃掉

desc.en: Live memory monitor with one-click cleanup when something runs away with it.
desc.zh: 即時監看記憶體,有東西失控時一鍵清理。

desc.en: An auto clicker that finds its target by image rather than by coordinates, so it still works when the window moves.
desc.zh: 靠圖像辨識找目標而不是記座標的自動點擊器,視窗移動了照樣有用。

tagline.zh: 用 Telegram 操控 Claude Code

desc.en: Send work to your machine and read the results from your phone.
desc.zh: 從手機派工作給你的電腦,結果也在手機上看。
